parameters.query:
SELECT 
    t.schemaname,
    t.tablename,
    c.column_name,
    c.data_type
FROM 
    pg_catalog.pg_tables t
JOIN 
    information_schema.columns c
    ON t.schemaname = c.table_schema
    AND t.tablename = c.table_name
WHERE 
    t.schemaname = 'public' AND c.table_name = 'ai_table_churnsheet'
ORDER BY 
    t.tablename, c.ordinal_position;
